issues.description: DS-012 technical deviation: `self._db.scalar(select(PriceMasterModel)...)` in create_price constructs a query directly in the service layer. DS-012 states 'Services depend on repositories — they never construct queries directly.' The canonical fix is a `PriceMasterRepository.find_duplicate(design_id, grade_id, effective_from)` method. However, T-083's output_files[] scope is limited to pricing_service.py and the plan.md pseudo-code explicitly specifies this pattern — adding a repo method requires modifying an out-of-scope file.
issues.fix_instruction: No in-scope fix possible. At T-090 or sprint-close, consider logging a TD entry to add PriceMasterRepository.find_duplicate() and replace the direct db.scalar() call. Accept as-is for this task iteration.

issues.description: TC-201 specifies `should_raise: 'HTTPException(status_code=409)'` but the implementation raises ConflictError (not HTTPException). The plan.md pseudo-code used HTTPException directly; the developer correctly adapted to the codebase's domain-exception pattern (ConflictError → error handler → HTTP 409). Via TestClient (HTTP-level), response.status_code==409 is satisfied. However if /ases-test-impl implements TC-201 as a unit test with pytest.raises(HTTPException), it will fail — it should instead catch ConflictError or use TestClient.
issues.fix_instruction: No fix required in pricing_service.py — ConflictError is the correct codebase pattern. At /ases-test-impl, implement TC-201 using FastAPI TestClient and assert response.status_code == 409, NOT pytest.raises(HTTPException). Alternatively, catch ConflictError in the unit test.
